|rulings=* The text referring to '[[Red 2]]' also applies to [[Red Squadron 1]] (it is the same starship persona).<ref name="scomp" />
* Permanent pilots never count as Red or Rogue Squadron.
* Any pilot character (e.g. [[Chewbacca]]) becomes a Red/Rogue Squadron pilot while they are piloting a Red/Rogue Squadron starship or vehicle.
* If opponent steals a Red/Rogue Squadron starship or vehicle and has a character piloting it, that is a Red/Rogue Squadron pilot, enabling Wedge to cancel a battle destiny.
* [[Admiral Raddus]]/Boshek/Boshek(V) are not Red/Rogue Squadron pilots by default (despite what's printed on their card). They still become one while piloting a Red/Rogue card, just like any other pilot.
